12/14/2024
Claim received for a collision in a parking lot. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go
through the attorney's office.
01/05/2025
Spoke with the insured driver, who confirmed the policy is in force and that they were the operator of the vehicle at
the time of the loss. Statement recorded and file opened.
03/10/2025
Police report obtained. It places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and records the account given by the other
driver, which matches the insured's description of the impact.
03/17/2025
Two independent witnesses gave statements that line up with the reported sequence of events. Scene photos
received and reviewed, and the damage shown is consistent with the described impact.
04/03/2025
Claimant reports a knee injury. The injury is plausible for a collision of this type, and treatment notes have been
requested from the treating provider.
04/13/2025
Medical records received. Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved, with no
unusual gaps or escalations noted.
04/15/2025
Prior records show a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which resolved fully without ongiong
complaints. Noted for the file.
04/26/2025
Claimant's counsel supplied a supplemental statement adding a few minor details. The core account remains the
same as the original statement.
07/13/2025
Prior claims database search returned an earlier accident involving the same vehicle, with major damage to the same
area. That incident was neevr reported to us and is now being presented as new damage. Refrered for further review.
07/18/2025
Reviewed the timing against the policy inception and found nothing suggesting the damage predates coverage. The
question for this file is the prior unreported incident, not the policy start.
07/28/2025
Coverage position on hold pending the review of the prior damage and a reconciliation with counsel. Further update
to follow once the review is complete.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
